name: skillbridge-ai
description: SkillBridge AI — From Skills to Opportunities. Built for BUILD FOR BHARAT 2.0 by Team THE PROCESSORS.

scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.build: cd client && npm run build && cd ../server && npm run build
scripts.db:push: cd server && npx prisma db push
scripts.db:seed: cd server && npx prisma db seed
